content.title: 'One Battle After Another' wins six Oscars, including best picture - as it happened
content.text: SummaryStars gathered Los Angeles for the 98th Academy Awards'One Battle After Another' wins six awards, including best picture'Sinners' wins four Oscars, with Michael B. Jordan scoring best actor'Frankenstein' wins three awards in design categories'KPop Demon Hunters' wins best animated feature, capping record-breaking runSee the full list of winnersIf you can’t see the content of video posts, please adjust your cookie settingsSterling K. Brown and host Conan O'Brien (left) perform during the Oscars, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeWe're closing down our live coverage of the 98th Academy Awards, with the ceremony over and attendees headed to afterparties - or maybe even home.Here's what you need to know.The darkly comic thriller “One Battle After Another” won best picture, leading a haul of six trophies on a night when Hollywood handed its top movie honors to unconventional ​stories.Vampire story "Sinners" won four awards including a best actor trophy for Michael B. Jordan who played twin brothers. Here are some more takeaways from the ceremony.COMEDIAN QUIPSHost Conan O'Brien warned that his presentations might get political. To those unhappy with that, he said they could attend an alternative show hosted by singer Kid Rock, who during the Super Bowl in February staged a competing halftime show to Bad Bunny's performance.Late-night TV host Jimmy Kimmel poked fun at President Donald Trump when announcing the documentary winners, saying, "Oh, is he going to be mad his wife wasn't nominated for this." First Lady Melania Trump's documentary wasn't released until 2026 so it did not qualify for the awards.SUPREMELY SHUTOUT"Marty Supreme" did not win any awards, including Timothee Chalamet losing best actor to Michael B. Jordan. Chalamet's loss follows his negative comments about the ballet and opera that sparked controversy online and led to a joke by O'Brien: “Security is extremely tight tonight. I’m told there are concerns about attacks from both the opera and ballet community.”RESISTANCE TAKES CENTER STAGE"Mr. Nobody Against Putin," about a Russian schoolteacher waging quiet resistance against Russia's war on Ukraine, won the Oscar for best documentary. Director David Borenstein said in his acceptance speech that a country is lost through small acts of complicity: "When we act complicit when a government murders people on the streets of our major cities, when we don't say anything when oligarchs take over the media and control how we can produce it and consume it". The comments followed the killing of two Americans in Minneapolis by immigration agents.IN MEMORIAMDirector Rob Reiner was honored by actor Billy Crystal after Reiner and his wife Michele were found dead at their home in December. Barbra Streisand, who played opposite Robert Redford in "The Way We Were," called him a an "intellectual cowboy" in her tribute, even singing a few lines from the movie's title song.A CEREMONY OF FIRSTSCassandra Kulukundis received the first ever award for best casting for “One Battle After Another” after the category was added this year. Autumn Durald Arkapaw became the first woman and first Black cinematographer to win the cinematography honor, "Golden" gave the KPop genre its first win in the best original song category and "Sentimental Value" became the first Norwegian film to win best international feature.A 'DEVIL WEARS PRADA' REUNIONAnne Hathaway joined Anna Wintour to present two awards in a “Devil Wears Prada” reunion ahead of the sequel due out in May. Director Paul Thomas Anderson and producer Sara Murphy of "One Battle after Another" at the Governors Ball afterparty., March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos BarriaMichael B. Jordan, best actor winner for "Sinners". Cassandra Kulukundis, winner of best casting for "One Battle after Another", and Jessie Buckley, winner of best actress for "Hamnet".Amy Madigan, winner of best supporting actress for "Weapons" with Ed Harris and their daughter Lily.Ryan Coogler, winner of best original screenplay for "Sinners" and Chris Appelhans, winner of best animated feature film for "KPop Demon Hunters".Jessie Buckley and Michael B. Jordan with their best actress and best actor awards. March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mario AnzuoniHere is the full list of Oscar winners at the 98th Academy Awards.BEST PICTURE - “One Battle After Another”BEST ACTOR - Michael B. Jordan, “Sinners”BEST ACTRESS - Jessie Buckley, “Hamnet”BEST DIRECTOR - Paul Thomas Anderson, “One Battle After Another”BEST SUPPORTING ACTOR - Sean Penn, “One Battle After Another”BEST SUPPORTING ACTRESS - Amy Madigan, “Weapons”BEST ORIGINAL SCREENPLAY - Ryan Coogler, “Sinners”BEST ADAPTED SCREENPLAY - Paul Thomas Anderson, “One Battle After Another”BEST ANIMATED FEATURE FILM - “KPop Demon Hunters”BEST ANIMATED SHORT FILM - "The Girl Who Cried Pearls”BEST CASTING - Cassandra Kulukundis, “One Battle after Another”BEST INTERNATIONAL FEATURE - “Sentimental Value”BEST DOCUMENTARY FEATURE - “Mr. Nobody Against Putin”BEST DOCUMENTARY SHORT - Joshua Seftel and Conall Jones, “All the Empty Rooms”BEST ORIGINAL SCORE - Ludwig Göransson, “Sinners”BEST ORIGINAL SONG - "Golden" from "KPop Demon Hunters"BEST SOUND - “F1”BEST PRODUCTION DESIGN - Tamara Deverell and Shane Vieau, “Frankenstein”BEST LIVE ACTION SHORT FILM - (TIE): “The Singers” and “Two People Exchanging Saliva”BEST CINEMATOGRAPHY - Autumn Durald Arkapaw, “Sinners”BEST MAKEUP AND HAIRSTYLING - “Frankenstein”BEST COSTUME DESIGN - “Frankenstein”BEST VISUAL EFFECTS - "Avatar: Fire and Ash”BEST FILM EDITING - Andy Jurgensen, “One Battle After Another”Watch our video report on the Oscars as the darkly comic thriller "One Battle After Another" claims the coveted best picture prize, winning a close contest with the vampire story "Sinners" at the highest honors in the film business.Earlier, we brought you some comments from Jimmy Kimmel, speaking before presenting the award for best documentary film.Kimmel said some unnamed countries don't believe in free speech but said he couldn't name them, before quipping, "Let's leave it at North Korea and CBS."He didn't elaborate, but he was likely referring to how fellow talk show host Stephen Colbert accused CBS of censorship after he was barred from airing an interview with a Democratic candidate for the U.S. Senate.Kimmel speaks onstage during the Oscars, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeCBS said the Colbert interview decision was based on the FCC's new guidance. FCC chair Brendan Carr later denied censorship.Under the Trump administration, the FCC has sought to assert more control of networks.Kimmel did not mention that his own late-night show was briefly suspended by ABC last year under pressure from the FCC but then restored.ABC is broadcasting the Oscars this year.This year's Oscars gave Hollywood a night to celebrate at a time of unease in the film business. Warner Bros, the studio behind big winners "One Battle After Another" and "Sinners," is in the process of being sold to Paramount in a deal that will narrow the ranks of major film distributors.Malgosia Turzanska on the red carpet March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos BarriaVarious celebrities on Sunday wore a pin saying, “ICE OUT” to protest ICE, the U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency.Thousands of protesters in Minneapolis have demanded the withdrawal of federal immigration agents from Minnesota following the fatal shootings of two U.S. citizens.Here’s a look back at past protests at the Oscars.2024/2025FILE PHOTO: Billie Eilish on the red carpet, March 10, 2024. REUTERS/Aude Guerrucci Celebrities wore pins calling for a ceasefire for Israel's war in Gaza and in support of Palestinians at the Oscars.2019 FILE PHOTO: Lee accepting the Best Adapted Screenplay award, February 24, 2019. REUTERS/Mike Blake Spike Lee called on voters to mobilize against hate ahead of the 2020 U.S. election after clinching best adapted screenplay award for “BlacKkKlansman”.The speech was widely seen as a rallying call against U.S. President Donald Trump. Trump certainly saw it that way, calling Lee's comments a "racist hit on your President" even though Lee never mentioned Trump.2018FILE PHOTO: McDormand accepting the Best Actress Oscar. March 4, 2018. REUTERS/Lucas Jackson In the fallout of the #MeToo scandal, best actress winner Frances McDormand used her speech to champion women in the film industry.2016 Leonardo DiCaprio said climate change was an “urgent threat” and called for action to tackle it as he accepted best actor for "The Revenant."2009 FILE PHOTO: Penn accepts his Oscar. February 22, 2009. REUTERS/Gary Hershorn Sean Penn rallied for gay rights while receiving best actor for “Milk,” a movie about slain San Francisco gay rights activist Harvey Milk.2003 FILE PHOTO: Moore making an anti-war statement. March 23, 2003. REUTERS/Mike BlakeFilmmaker Michael Moore called the reasons behind the Iraq war “fictitious” while accepting best documentary feature for “Bowling for Columbine.”1973 Native American actress and activist Sacheen Littlefeather declined the best actor award on behalf of Marlon Brando to protest the film industry's mistreatment of Indigenous people.The best picture winner was not the top-earning film among the 10 nominees for the award."One Battle After Another" has earned $209,380,823 as of Friday, according to IMDb’s Box Office Mojo:Here are the gross earnings of the other nominees, in order of money brought in."F1" - $633,242,436"Sinners" - $369,289,632"Marty Supreme" - $274,459,312"Hamnet" - $96,306,075"Bugonia" - $42,972,839"Sentimental Value" - $22,114,444"The Secret Agent" - $17,981,256"Frankenstein" - n/a, limited release"Train Dreams" - n/a, limited releaseSo how do these compare with some of the highest ever grossing winners and nominees across all categories?The top five have all crossed the $2 billion mark:Avatar (2009) - $2.9 billion (winner)Avengers: Endgame (2019) - $2.8 billion (nominee) Avatar: The Way of Water (2022) - $2.3 billion (winner)Titanic (1997) - $2.26 billion (winner)Star Wars: Episode VII - The Force Awakens (2015) - $2.07 billion (nominee)When an Academy Award winner brings their award to the press room, the process is not yet complete. Once they take it to be engraved, it's officially their Oscar.Anderson and Teyana Taylor accept the Oscar for Best Picture for "One Battle after Another", REUTERS/Mike Blake“One Battle After Another” stars Leonardo DiCaprio who plays a washed-up revolutionary whose daughter is kidnapped.The film has won six awards tonight."My heart is exploding with gratitude," said producer Sara Murphy.Director Paul Thomas Anderson said, "What a night, you guys, let's have a martini." Buckley reacts as she wins for best actress, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeJessie Buckley won best actress for her performance in “Hamnet.”"Thank you so much. This is, this is really something," Buckley said in disbelief, as she held her award.""I would like to dedicate this to the beautiful chaos of a mother's heart," she said.The drama offers a fictional account of the relationship between William Shakespeare and his wife Agnes and the death of their 11-year-old son Hamnet in 1596."What was revealed to me through her (Agnes) was a tenderness that I didn't know I needed to learn and live in. And that tenderness has changed me," Buckley said at the movie's London Film Festival premiere in October.The Irish actress was previously nominated for best supporting actress for “The Lost Daughter” in 2021.Jordan after winning the Oscar for best actor, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeMichael B. Jordan picked up the top male acting prize for playing twins in the supernatural action thriller “Sinners"."God is good," he said in his acceptance speech."I stand here because of the people who came before me," he said before naming award winning Black actors.Director Ryan Coogler has cast Jordan in all of his other films: 2013’s “Fruitvale Station,” 2015’s “Creed,” 2018's “Black Panther” and 2022’s “Black Panther: Wakanda Forever.”"Ryan (director Ryan Coogler) wanted me to step outside my comfort zone and he challenged me a little bit. When he told me the roles and the storyline, it was an easy yes for me, even though I don't really watch horrors like that," Jordan said at the film's London premiere in April.Anderson at the Oscars, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakePaul Thomas Anderson won best director for his work on the comedic thriller “One Battle After Another.”In his acceptance speech, Anderson said, "You make a guy work hard for one of these, I really appreciate it."Anderson was nominated for two other Oscars – best picture and adapted screenplay – for the film, which tells the story of a former radical trying to save his daughter from kidnappers.The filmmaker had previously been nominated for best picture, director and original screenplay for 2021’s “Licorice Pizza”; best picture and director for 2017’s “Phantom Thread”; best adapted screenplay for 2014’s “Inherent Vice”; best picture, director and adapted screenplay for 2007’s “There Will Be Blood”; best original screenplay for 1999’s “Magnolia” and best original screenplay for 1997’s “Boogie Nights.” However he went home empty handed every time before tonight.The prestigious awards for best director, best actor, best actress and best film are up next.Best film is usually the last award of the night.Actors Priyanka Chopra and Javier Bardem presented best foreign film."No to war and free Palestine," said Bardem, to applause. In Gaza there have been regular outbreaks of violence ​since a ceasefire went into effect in October, following two years of devastating war triggered by Hamas-led attacks in Israel on October 7, 2023.Bardem and Chopra Jonas, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeEJAE accepted the award, saying the win wasn't about success. "It's about resilience," she said. Brazilian political thriller "The Secret Agent" is nominated for best picture and its star Wagner Moura is nominated for best actor.It was also nominated - but missed out on - the award for best international feature film and best casting.People gather to watch a live broadcast of the Oscars at Cinema Sao Luiz, which served as a filming location for "The Secret Agent," in Recife, Brazil, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Diego NigroREUTERS/Diego NigroREUTERS/Diego NigroREUTERS/Diego NigroREUTERS/Diego NigroDirector Joachim Trier wins the Oscar for Best International Feature Film for "Sentimental Value", March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Mike BlakeJoachim Trier’s family drama "Sentimental Value" stars Renate Reinsve as stage actress Nora, who has a complicated relationship with her estranged father, a past-his-prime filmmaker portrayed by Stellan Skarsgard.Both “The Secret Agent” (Brazil) and “It Was Just an Accident” (France) share gripping tales of life under authoritarian rule.Moura on the red carpet, March 15, 2026. REUTERS/Carlos BarriaPolitical thriller "The Secret Agent" from Brazil's Kleber Mendonca Filho stars Wagner Moura as a dissident caught up in the political turmoil during that country’s military dictatorship in 1977. “’The Secret Agent’ is a film about memory - or the lack of memory - and generational trauma,” Moura said in his Golden Globe acceptance speech in January.FILE PHOTO: Panahi and cast members of "Un simple accident" (It Was Just an Accident) in Cannes, France, May 20, 2025. REUTERS/Stephane Mahe"It Was Just an Accident" follows a garage owner who rashly kidnaps a one-legged man who looks like the government officer who tortured him.The protagonist along with three others who had also been tortured by the officer years ago must try to identify him and decide his fate. The film itself was shot clandestinely in Iran, and its director Jafar Panahi has been imprisoned by the Iranian government multiple times. Show More Posts
